Hi Tessa,

We need Redwood Inference to be registered in our AP system ahead of the final contract signature so we can issue POs and process invoices. Can you provide the following so we can complete the vendor profile?

- Legal name and remit-to address used on invoices
- Tax identifier (TIN or VAT as applicable) and W-9 / W-8 form
- Preferred payment method (ACH or Wire) and banking details or letter of authorization
- Invoice format requirements (does Sapphire require PO on the invoice header, PDF naming convention, single PDF per invoice)
- Contact for billing disputes / remittance queries

Our vendor portal is here: https://sapphire.co/vendor-portal/register?ref=RDW. If you can upload the documents there it speeds things up.

We also need to confirm PO matching rules (3-way match? PO required on all invoices?) so our procurements team doesn't have any unexpected holds. Ideally we can onboard you this week.

Thanks,

Marta

Hi Tessa — thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the docs. I confirm the following from our side so you can complete the registration: 

- Vendor portal: we have created Vendor ID RDW-987654 for Redwood Inference — please use that when referencing invoice submissions.
- PO requirements: PO must be present on the invoice header. If missing, invoice will route to our procurements queue which delays payment.
- PDF naming: please use Invoice_Redwood_PO{PO_NUMBER}_{YYYYMMDD}.pdf; single PDF per invoice is required.
- Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt, ACH preferred; wire acceptable for initial deposit (wire fees withheld by sender).
- Matching: We perform 2-way match by default; for goods that require receiving confirmation we will flag 3-way match. If your invoice lines match the PO number and quantities we should be good.
- Tax: For US entities we need a completed W-9 (received). For EU cross-border cases, the self-cert is sufficient for now; we'll request VAT number if our tax team flags it during vendor onboarding.

Next steps for Redwood (per our portal workflow):
1) Upload W-9 and bank-letter to portal and confirm last 4 digits of account.
2) Confirm PDF naming convention on first invoice.
3) When you receive the PO, include Vendor ID RDW-987654 and PO on header.

I've attached the portal confirmation and a filled AP packet back with our standard fields pre-populated for Redwood (Sapphire_AP_Packet_Filled.pdf). Once the portal is complete we'd expect first invoice to be paid on Net-30.

Let me know if you'd like a quick 15-min call to go through the portal fields.

Best,

Marta
Supplier Enablement | Sapphire Labs
